items.markdown:
Cost per hire (CPH) is the average amount a company spends to recruit a new employee, typically ranging `between $4,500 and $4,800` . It is calculated by dividing the sum of internal and external recruiting costs by the total number of hires in a given period.[](https://juicebox.ai/blog/cost-per-hire) [[1]](https://juicebox.ai/blog/cost-per-hire)[[2]](https://www.teamed.global/insights/cost-per-hire-calculator-shrm-formula-and-benchmarks)

The industry standard formula for this calculation is:[](https://x0pa.com/glossary/cost-per-hire/) [[1]](https://x0pa.com/glossary/cost-per-hire/)[[2]](https://x0pa.com/calculators/cost-per-hire/)

Cost Per Hire=Internal Costs+External Costs Total Number of Hires Cost Per Hire equals the fraction with numerator Internal Costs plus External Costs and denominator Total Number of Hires end-fraction C o s t P e r H i r e=I n t e r n a l C o s t s+E x t e r n a l C o s t s T o t a l N u m b e r o f H i r e s

What It Includes

- **Internal Costs:** Prorated recruiter and HR salaries, employee referral awards, and the time hiring managers spend interviewing and evaluating candidates.[](https://x0pa.com/calculators/cost-per-hire/) 
- **External Costs:** Job board fees, agency/search firm fees, ATS (Applicant Tracking System) costs, background checks, and candidate travel or relocation expenses.[](https://x0pa.com/calculators/cost-per-hire/) 

Benchmarks & Variations

Average costs vary significantly based on company size, industry, and role seniority . For example, hiring for specialized technical roles or C-suite executive positions can cost anywhere from $15,000 to over $30,000.[](https://www.metrichq.org/human-resources/cost-per-hire/) [[1]](https://www.metrichq.org/human-resources/cost-per-hire/)

How to Use the Metric Tracking this metric quarterly helps companies optimize their recruitment budgets, justify spending, and assess the ROI of different hiring channels. To ensure you capture all hidden expenditures, use resources like the SHRM Cost-Per-Hire Standard to build a consistent internal tracking process.[](https://www.paylocity.com/resources/glossary/cost-per-hire/) [[1]](https://www.paylocity.com/resources/glossary/cost-per-hire/)
